name.fr-FR: Élévations à Dieu sur tous les mystères de la religion chrétienne
name.en-US: Elevations to God on All the Mysteries of the Christian Religion
name.pt-BR: Elevações a Deus sobre todos os mistérios da religião cristã

description.fr-FR: Vingt-cinq semaines de méditations, chacune en une suite d’« élévations » : de l’unité et de la perfection de Dieu, de la Trinité, de la création, de la chute, des prophéties, jusqu’à l’enfance et au ministère du Christ. Œuvre posthume (1727) écrite pour les religieuses de Meaux, une des sommes de la spiritualité française du Grand Siècle. Édition Lachat (1862).
description.en-US: Twenty-five weeks of meditations, each a run of “elevations”: on the unity and perfection of God, the Trinity, creation, the fall, the prophecies, down to the childhood and ministry of Christ. A posthumous work (1727) written for the nuns of Meaux, a summit of French seventeenth-century spirituality. Lachat edition (1862).
description.pt-BR: Vinte e cinco semanas de meditações, cada uma em uma série de «elevações»: sobre a unidade e a perfeição de Deus, a Trindade, a criação, a queda, as profecias, até a infância e o ministério de Cristo. Obra póstuma (1727), escrita para as religiosas de Meaux, um dos cumes da espiritualidade francesa do Grande Século. Edição Lachat (1862).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume VII, pages 002-027. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
